HONEST NEGATIVE expected if the paint is structural.
approach: MEASURE FIRST. (1) Static decomposition of the TUI open path at the tip (run.rs/session_ui.rs/snapshot.rs/view): connect -> hello -> create/attach RPC -> reconstruct(fold ALL) -> subscribe_roster -> fetch_heartbeat_catalog + fetch_bash_activities (awaited, DockFold::FirstFrame zero-shift geometry) -> refresh_stats -> rebuild_view -> ONE full repaint (layout_pass counts every entry; the sparse window bounds the RENDER, not the count); the interactive loop starts only AFTER the open completes, so early-key-visible == launch-to-ready on every flow (keys queue in the channel through the open). (2) The phase instrument: an env-gated JSONL trace (PRIME_AGENT_AP_TRACE; probe-only, identical patch on BOTH arms) at open_start/create_sent/create_done/attach_sent/attach_done/attach_msgs/reconstructed/roster_done/hb_done/bash_done/stats/rebuilt/frame/chrome/frame_inline + the kpc-shaped PTYSession driver (per-chunk ledger + pyte echo watch + worker-socket/process-sighting grids). (3) The legs: new (fresh session, silent pty), warm (TUI#1 ready then killed; TUI#2 --resume <active-id>), resume fixtures (small 607KB/159 rows, real 12.99MB/11,923 rows) x keys at +10..+200ms, ABBA base,cand,cand,base. (4) THE CUT (the shared core, per the orchestrator's convergence directive): transcript_replay(messages) -> (entries, Option<notice>) inside snapshot.rs — order_messages_for_transcript -> initial_render_window (the TS initialRenderMessages + omitOrphanToolResults port, INITIAL_TRANSCRIPT_RENDER_MESSAGE_LIMIT=400) -> the fold; transcript_to_entries = the notice-free wrapper; reconstruct carries Reconstructed.transcript_notice; attach_session prepends ChatEntry::TranscriptNotice to pending_snapshot; rebuild_transcript (compaction) pushes it first — all replay call sites inherit exactly like TS. Plus the one-line run.rs fix: UiInput::ScrollTop now sets session.dirty (the headless capture never re-rendered the scrolled window without it; the terminal path's inline paint was unaffected; the step's own documented contract needed it).
parity_notes: TS derivation (recon: /home/ubuntu/attach-paint-ts-recon.md, TS @ cd1f215): TS paints header+editor skeleton at ui.start() then renders the capped window in ONE sync loop + ONE requestRender — the Rust one-full-repaint IS TS-parity in pass shape; THE GAP WAS THE INPUT BOUND (TS 400-cap + stitch + notice; the port folded ALL messages). All four TS renderSessionContext call sites pass limitTranscript: true (initial :7362, resync :3556, compaction rebuild :7431) — the port seam covers the same three flows through the shared fold. TS createDaemonClientConnection (main.ts:1046-1090) performs the create/attach BEFORE the InteractiveMode exists on the CLI path — the CLI user cannot type during the open in TS either, so input-during-open (candidate B) is NOT parity-restoring: REJECTED WITH EVIDENCE (the port's net shape already matches; the port even paints the startup chrome during the create wall on the New flow, friendlier than TS's blank). Frozen surfaces: the under-400 replay is byte-identical (no notice row, no spacing change — pinned by the e2e under-limit arm + the existing orphan-card tests); the wire and all daemon-side state stay full-set (TS ships the whole history; the bound is render-side only; the port never populated editor history at attach, so TS populateHistory has no counterpart to preserve). DISCLOSED EDGE: a dangling toolResult (a toolCallId no assistant carries) DROPS in the capped window (TS omitOrphanToolResults exact) while the port's under-limit replay KEEPS the standalone orphan card (the live-path twin contract, unchanged). The notice: ChatEntry::TranscriptNotice (dim text + the blank AFTER — TS Text+Spacer(1), the reverse of showStatus rows) as the FIRST entry of a capped rebuild; above the fold at attach exactly like TS (the viewport follows the tail).
